last_result_summary: 578a kept the shared 577 architecture and replaced independent source noise with a full-path empirical Gaussian source over standardized (30,38) increments. Best val loss was 2.5768. Finite sample rates stayed 1.0 and standardized increment std ratio fell to 1.088. Reconstructed IV max improved from the 577 range of 134k to 3.5M down to about 194, confirming source geometry matters. Factor max still reached about 3.76M because training data contains non-positive/zero-filled price-like factor levels that create artificial log-transform floor jumps.
